Frequently asked questions

Clear answers before we start.

The practical details about process, platforms, pricing, ownership, and working together.

NuvelloWeb is a founder-led studio. You work directly with the person responsible for strategy and delivery, with clear scope and fewer layers between the conversation and the work.

Sometimes a well-supported theme, platform, or builder is the right business choice; other projects benefit from a more custom approach. We recommend tools based on goals, budget, ownership, and long-term maintenance.

NuvelloWeb is based in Los Angeles, California, and works with both local and remote clients.

It begins with a discovery conversation. We clarify goals, audience, constraints, scope, and timing before proposing the work.

A focused website may take a few weeks. Larger sites, custom functionality, commerce, or content-heavy projects take longer. Your proposal includes a schedule tailored to the actual scope.

Pricing depends on the number of pages, content needs, platform, integrations, and level of custom work. You receive a clear scope and price before work begins. Read our full Los Angeles website pricing guide.

Yes. Responsive behavior is part of every website engagement, along with modern browser and usability checks.

When content editing is an important requirement, we recommend a platform and setup that gives your team practical control. Training or documentation can be included.

We can advise on hosting and configure deployment as part of a project. Hosting ownership, billing, backups, and support responsibilities are documented clearly.

Yes. We can audit, redesign, migrate, optimize, or selectively improve an existing site depending on its condition and your goals.

Project work is typically scoped with defined phases and payment terms. Ongoing SEO, marketing, or maintenance uses a separate agreement with clearly stated terms.

You receive the agreed handoff and access. Ongoing maintenance, marketing, SEO, and improvement support are available when needed.
